messages:
Ava: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands Q&A. Leaving a short thread to capture RCA links and action owners for follow-up. Pls confirm if anything's incorrect.

Tyler: Link to RCA I uploaded: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-07. I can own the autoscaler flaps follow-ups (runbook + tests). ETA: end of week.

Jana: Im taking the detection-threshold sims and verification. Will run sims tonight and post numbers tomorrow morning.

Leo: Quick clarification on SLOs: leadership said we should not change public SLOs now, only adjust internal alert thresholds for the short experiments, correct?

Ava: Correct. No customer-facing SLO changes for now. Update roadmap notes to reflect that and mark the alert tweaks as experimental.

Olivia: Added a verification column in the follow-up spreadsheet (folder link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-reliability-followups. I created a sheet named "post-allhands-actions".

Tyler: Example smoke test I'll add to the sheet:
```
# smoke test
ab -n 200 -c 10 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
# expect p99 < 350ms
```

Jana: For the alert threshold experiment I propose 48h in staging + 24h in prod with an automated rollback if error-rate delta > 0.2%. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Leo: Add a dashboard tile to show error-rate delta and tie a temporary pager rule for the canary. I'll own the dashboard work. ETA ~48h.

Ava: Good plan. Engineering leadership will review after the 72h total canary. Add the temp pager rule and tag me.

sre-bot: INC-2026-07 RCA uploaded by @Tyler at 2167894400  artifacts: logs, flamegraphs, heapdumps.

Tyler: Runbook PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/reliability/pull/482. Assigning @Ava for review and @Leo to add dashboard changes.

Olivia: Can owners add verification dates in the spreadsheet by EOD so PMs can get the export?

Ava: Action summary for easy copy: - Tyler: runbook + smoke tests (ETA EOW) - Jana: threshold sims + verification (ETA next morning) - Leo: dashboard tile + pager rule (ETA 48h) - Olivia: verification column maintained and export for PM (ETA EOD)

Tyler: I'll post a short note in #eng-sre with the smoke test snippet and link to the PR.

Jana: If anyone wants to pair during the staging canary on Thursday morning, ping me. Would like a second pair of eyes.

Ava: Thanks all. If blockers surface escalate to me or drop into #release-war-room. Closing this thread once all ETAs are in the spreadsheet. :white_check_mark:
